title: Sleeping Beauty Miner: An Integrity-Aware, Time-Safe Agent for Discovering Delayed and Under-Recognized Scientific Work
domain: metascience / scientometrics / delayed recognition / science of science / machine learning / citation networks / research integrity
summary: An open-data-first, auditable agent that retrospectively identifies delayed-recognition patterns and supports time-safe prospective rediscovery ranking using citation trajectories, semantic and network evidence, Prince signals, optional technological transfer, and ARIS4C011 integrity/provenance gating.

dependencies.011: research-forensics evidence safety, provenance, citation verification, applicability and ABSTAIN semantics
dependencies.005: downstream exploratory input for opportunity-cost / buried-science analyses

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design with live prior-art audit and explicit reuse of ARIS4C011 architecture
